en: A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a distant view of a large hilltop castle with a central tower and multiple wings, surrounded by forested hills. To the right stands a separate church or chapel tower with a spire. In the foreground, out-of-focus tables and a railing suggest a terrace viewpoint framed by tree branches. Red printed German text appears in the sky area at the upper right.
